confluence_add_comment: Add a comment to a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_create_page: Create a new Confluence wiki page (docs, handbook, onboarding, meeting notes, runbooks) under a space.
confluence_delete_page: Permanently delete a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_get_comments: Get the comments left on a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_get_inline_comments: Get the inline (text-selection) comments on a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_get_page_children: List the child pages and folders nested under a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_get_page_history: Get a past version/revision of a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_move_page: Move a Confluence wiki page to a different parent page or space.
confluence_reply_to_comment: Reply to an existing comment thread on a Confluence wiki page.
confluence_search: Search Confluence wiki pages and spaces by keywords or CQL: documentation, handbooks, onboarding guides, runbooks, meeting notes, internal docs, and other knowledge-base content.
confluence_update_page: Edit/update the content of an existing Confluence wiki page.
jira_add_comment: Add a comment to a Jira issue or ticket, visible on the issue's activity/comment feed.
jira_add_issues_to_sprint: Add one or more existing Jira issues/tickets to a sprint (agile board iteration).
jira_add_watcher: Add a user as a watcher to a Jira issue so they get notified of updates/comments on that ticket.
jira_add_worklog: Log time spent (a worklog entry) against a Jira issue, e.g. hours worked on a ticket.
jira_batch_create_issues: Create multiple Jira issues/tickets at once in a single batch call.
jira_batch_create_versions: Create multiple fix versions/releases at once in a Jira project.
jira_batch_get_changelogs: Get the field-change history (changelog: status, assignee, etc. changes) for multiple Jira issues at once (Cloud only).
jira_create_customer_request: Create a Jira Service Management (JSM) customer/support request, e.g. a help desk ticket.
jira_create_issue_link: Link two Jira issues together (e.g. 'blocks', 'relates to', 'duplicates').
jira_create_sprint: Create a new sprint (agile iteration) on a Jira Scrum board.
jira_create_version: Create a new fix version/release in a Jira project, used to tag which release an issue ships in.
jira_edit_comment: Edit the text of an existing comment on a Jira issue.
jira_get_agile_boards: Find Jira agile/Scrum/Kanban boards by name, project key, or board type.
jira_get_all_projects: List all Jira projects the current user can access, with their keys.
jira_get_board_issues: Get the issues/tickets on a Jira agile board, optionally filtered by JQL.
jira_get_issue_watchers: List the users watching (subscribed to notifications for) a Jira issue.
jira_get_link_types: List the kinds of issue links Jira supports (e.g. blocks, relates to, duplicates, is caused by).
jira_get_project_components: List the components (feature areas/subsystems) configured for a Jira project.
jira_get_project_issues: List all issues/tickets belonging to a specific Jira project.
jira_get_project_versions: List the fix versions/releases defined for a Jira project.
jira_get_sprint_issues: Get the issues/tickets assigned to a specific Jira sprint.
jira_get_sprints_from_board: List the sprints (active, future, or closed) on a Jira agile board.
jira_get_transitions: List the workflow transitions (status changes, e.g. To Do -> In Progress -> Done) available for a Jira issue right now.
jira_get_user_profile: Look up a Jira user's profile (display name, email, account id) by name or account id.
jira_get_worklog: Get the logged work/time-tracking entries recorded against a Jira issue.
jira_link_to_epic: Attach an existing Jira issue to an epic as its parent.
jira_move_issues_to_backlog: Move Jira issues out of their current sprint and back into the backlog.
jira_remove_issue_link: Remove an existing link between two Jira issues.
jira_remove_watcher: Stop a user from watching (receiving notifications for) a Jira issue.
jira_search: Search Jira issues/tickets with JQL (Jira Query Language), e.g. by project, status, assignee, or free text.
jira_search_fields: Find Jira field ids/names by keyword (fuzzy match), for building JQL or specifying which fields to return.
jira_transition_issue: Move a Jira issue through its workflow to a new status, e.g. resolve, close, or reopen a ticket.
jira_update_sprint: Update a Jira sprint's name, goal, or start/end dates.
